{{Quote|Villains, barbarians, and thieves! The universe will sing when the final Ebruchi exhales his last breath.|Potentate Tambocell|<ref name="Endnotes" />}}
[[Potentate]] '''Tambocell''' was an individual affiliated with the [[Geroon Nation]], which shared its name with<ref name="Endnotes" /> the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions']] [[Geroon (species)|Geroon]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="OBF">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref> and its [[Geroon|eponymous]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Geroon system/Legends|Geroon system]]</ref> [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="OBF" /> At some point, Tambocell proclaimed that the "[[Universe/Legends|universe]]" would "[[Music/Legends|sing]]" when the last member of the [[Ebruchi]] [[Species/Legends|species]], which was known for its culture of [[Pirate/Legends|piracy]] and which the potentate characterized as "villains, barbarians, and [[Thief/Legends|thieves]]," [[Death/Legends|perished]].<ref name="Endnotes" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tambocell was set to be introduced in a pull-quote for the Ebruchi entry of the<ref name="Endnotes" /> [[2010]]<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref> sourcebook ''[[The Unknown Regions]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''; however, the quote was cut from the sourcebook due to lack of space.<ref name="Endnotes" />
